title: Te Manawanui o te Wairua e Pōuritia ana
intro: I roto i ngā pukapuka hītori, kei reira tētahi tangata e hono ana tōna ingoa ki te manawanui. I whakamatautauria tēnei tangata ki te ngaronga o ngā whakamarie katoa o te ao, engari i noho tonu ia hei pononga pono mā te Kaihanga. I roto i ngā tau maha o te uauatanga me te mate tinana, i mau tonu te ngākau o tēnei wairua ki te whakapono, hei tohu mō te tumanako mō te hunga katoa e pāngia ana e te raruraru.
clues: He pononga pono ahau nā Allah, i manaakitia ki te nui o te taonga, ki te tini o ngā tamariki, ā, ki te hauora pai rawa atu.
I huri tōku ao i te wā i tangohia ai aku taonga me tōku whānau, ā, ko tōku whakapono anake te mea i mahue.
I pāngia ahau e te mate roa, mamae hoki, i whakamātautau i ngā rohe o te manawanui o te tangata.
I roto i tōku mamae, i whakakahore ahau ki te amuamu ki tōku Ariki, ahakoa i ngana te hoariri ki te arahi i ahau ki te ngakau pouri.
I taku karangatanga atu ki tōku Ariki, kāore au i tono taonga, engari i whakaae noa ahau kua pā mai te mamae ki ahau.
I kīia mai kia patua e ahau te whenua ki tōku waewae, ā, i puta mai i reira he puna wai matao hei whakaora i tōku tinana, hei whakamāmā hoki i tōku matewai.
